text:
The condominium passes outside probate to Kathy by right of survivorship as the surviving tenant by the entirety. Despite the prenuptial waiver, Kathy also receives her statutory pretermitted-spouse share—one-half of the probate estate, since Bill’s descendants are not hers—and, after that share is satisfied through applicable abatement rules, the remaining property passes under the will, with the pasture land to Tommy and the residue equally to Tommy and Julie.

CONFIDENCE: 97
